instruction: Buy me a kitchen timer on amazon within $10 (excluding tax) and have it delivered to my home address.
notes: Single-app purchase task. The product is a planning object whose static facts (product-matches, price-within) encode the task constraints: type kitchen timer and price <= $10 excluding tax; search_products is called with query='kitchen timer' and max_price=10 and reveals the product id. Quantity 1 is modeled explicitly via the optional quantity argument so the order has exactly one item. The delivery address is discovered via amazon.show_addresses (select the address named 'Home'); no address is added/updated/deleted, consistent with the evaluation. A payment card id is discovered via show_payment_cards. place_order consumes the cart and produces (ordered product address quantity); supervisor-complete-task carries the order record as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal condition, is nullary at the API level (no answer), and is forced last. Gmail/file_system record changes in the evaluation are automatic side effects of place_order and need no extra actions.
